title: The Last Mile
text: Pilgrims walk the last mile to the shrine on their knees, the road worn into two grooves by centuries of it, the stones dark with old blood. A monk at the milestone says it is the only way to be heard. He is very sure of this. His own knees are scarred white.

options.label: Each Scion walks it on their knees.

outcomes.text: Bloody knees, and a quiet mind.

options.label: Each Scion walks it on their feet.
